thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. Yahoo at 12:00Z says oil prices fall on an Iran deal while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rise, which supports keeping QQQ rather than selling it, and it is the opposite of an energy buy. Google's four-pronged AI strategy 'could' leapfrog Nvidia is an opinion headline with an empty summary; QQQ already holds both, and the same pack still has Nvidia's multi-year SK Hynix memory deal, so I will not sell NVDA or IWM to add GOOGL. A Chinese startup beating Apple and Meta to coding glasses names AAPL and META but states no result in the summary. Carlyle's $2.8bn MAI stake, Toast's higher EBITDA outlook, the floated $1B IBM quantum award, AppLovin and Gibraltar forecasts, and the Moderna 'does it need to make money' question have no open in the tape. SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Databricks, and Canva are not listed. Yesterday's NU, PAAS, HHH, PSX, C, and HPE items still have no open. No small-cap item against IWM. House PTRs are filings only, with no tickers.
